body:
Pink Scolecite is a rare and stunning gem that holds all of the spirit-expanding possibilities of Scolecite, but vibrates with a soothing, balancing energy that gently supports your soul work. With its ray-like soft pink inclusions, this crystal holds special healing energy for the heart chakra. It reminds you to be kind to yourself, even as you continue to strive toward ascension.

Scolecite, in general, is a stone of ascension and spiritual evolution that inspires deeper awareness and higher consciousness. Its starburst essence carries a limitless and cosmic energy, helping to boost manifestation and expand your potential like a dazzling star.

Pink Scolecite is an ideal gem for meditation, bringing an infusion of heart-centered energy to your practice. When your thoughts are scattered, this stone balances the left and right hemispheres of the brain. Working with it helps to align your energy, allowing the flow of universal love to lift your spirits and nurture your soul.
